name: std::ranges::transform_view<V,F>::size

declarations.code:
constexpr auto size() const
    requires ranges::sized_range<const V>;

intro:
Returns the number of elements.

Returns ranges::size(base_), where base_ is the underlying view.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: If V does not model forward_range, size() might not be well-defined after a call to begin().

examples.output: THE LENGTH OF THIS STRING IS 42 CHARACTERS
